'Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!' Reveals Additional Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Maro Muchi's Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! (There Is Also a Hole in the Student Organization!) manga revealed additional staff, the opening theme, and first promotional video on Saturday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 12.30 a.m. on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV, and Tochigi TV. 'Fate/strange Fake' New Season Announced
The Fate/strange Fake stage at Anime NYC 2026 announced that a new season is in production and revealed a teaser visual (pictured) on Friday. A-1 Pictures produced an anime special, subtitled as Whispers of Dawn aired in July 2023 at Anime Expo 2023, followed by the first season airing in Winter 2026.
